dialogue.text: The first morning of the new school term -- and Aoi is already running late.
No, no, no -- not on the very first day!
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: fear

dialogue.text: At the station gate, a crowd bunches up beneath the departure board.
A red notice flashes: signal trouble. Trains on Aoi's line are delayed.
You've got to be kidding me. Today of all days?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: surprise

dialogue.text: She hops on her toes, craning for the platform.
Okay, okay. Don't panic. Fast walk, transfer, survive.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: fear

dialogue.text: By the time she reaches school, the first bell is already fading.
Made it! Barely! I am never trusting that line again.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: happiness

dialogue.text: She slips off her shoes, jams on her indoor pair, and rushes down the hall with the class list in hand.
Year one, class three... end of the hall, right?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: neutral

dialogue.text: She slides open a door and steps in with a bright, breathless grin.
Good morning! Sorry I'm la—
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: happiness

dialogue.text: Thirty unfamiliar faces stare back. A second-year homeroom.
Can I help you?
dialogue.speaker: Teacher

dialogue.text: ...Nope! Wrong dramatic entrance!
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: happiness

dialogue.text: A few students laugh. Heat floods her face as she backs out and shuts the door.
Amazing. Absolute master class, Aoi.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: happiness

dialogue.text: She checks the paper again and freezes.
Class 1-3 is in the north building, not the main one.
What kind of map prints north in six-point font?!
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: anger

dialogue.text: She sprints across the courtyard, bag thumping against her side.
Come on, come on... please let the teacher be nice.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: fear

dialogue.text: At the entrance to the north building, a girl from her year holds the door open.
You too?
dialogue.speaker: Miyu

dialogue.text: Please tell me you're also in 1-3 and not judging me too hard.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: happiness

dialogue.text: I'm in 1-3. And I got lost first, so you're safe.
dialogue.speaker: Miyu

dialogue.text: Aoi lets out a short, helpless laugh, the knot in her chest loosening.
Then lead the way, hero. I'll owe you my life for at least one lunch break.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: happiness

dialogue.text: They arrive outside the right room. The teacher is taking attendance.
Excuse me! Sorry we're late!
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: happiness

dialogue.text: Signal trouble and wrong building?
dialogue.speaker: Teacher

dialogue.text: Aoi blinks.
That obvious, huh?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: happiness

dialogue.text: It is on the first day. Come in. Find seats.
dialogue.speaker: Teacher

dialogue.text: A small wave of relieved laughter passes through the room.
Thank you! I swear this is not my usual brand.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: happiness

dialogue.text: She drops into the empty seat beside Miyu and exhales for what feels like the first time all morning.
Okay. New term status: messy start, but not a total disaster.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: happiness
